plugins.name: Reverse Delay
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Records a window and plays it back in reverse — Pink Floyd / shoegaze swells. Feedback piles nested reversals into a swelling cloud.

plugins.name: Tape Delay
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Single-tap feedback delay with a low-pass on each repeat so echoes darken into a warm soup — analog tape style rather than harsh digital reps.

plugins.name: Octaver
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Full-wave rectification produces a signal one octave UP, DC-blocked and mixed under the dry. Classic fuzz-octaver flavour — gritty 8va parallel.

plugins.name: Ring Mod
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Multiplies input by a sine carrier. Low carrier = tremolo; speech-band = Dalek robot; above 1 kHz = clangorous bell-tone.

plugins.name: Saturator
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Soft-clip tube-style saturation. Drive pushes the signal into the tanh curve; mix blends back the dry path so even extreme drive sits in a mix.

plugins.name: Compressor
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Feedforward peak compressor with split attack/release detector, soft-knee gain computer in the dB domain, and makeup gain. Tames vocal peaks, glues mixes.

plugins.name: De-esser
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Split-band sibilance ducker. Sidechain HP feeds an envelope follower that drops gain only on the HF band of the main signal — voice body stays intact, only the harsh sssss gets tamed.

plugins.name: Limiter
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Brickwall peak limiter with 8 ms lookahead. Detector sees what's coming and clamps gain before peaks reach the output — last-stage master-bus glue at 0 dBFS.

plugins.name: Noise Gate
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Hysteresis-based gate with attack/hold/release. Cleans up background hiss between phrases, kills bleed between drum mics, makes a noisy room presentable.

plugins.name: Transient Shaper
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Independent attack/sustain control via the difference of fast and slow envelopes. SPL Transient Designer in spirit — fatten snares, soften plosives, add bite to vocals.

plugins.name: Exciter
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Aphex-style high-frequency harmonic generator. Splits highs, runs them through asymmetric soft-clip, sums the new harmonics back under dry. Re-airs dull vocals and cassette transfers.

plugins.name: Parametric EQ
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Three RBJ biquad bands — low shelf, peaking bell with Q, high shelf. Channel-strip tone shaping with cookbook-accurate filter math.

plugins.name: Auto-Wah
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Envelope-following band-pass. Loud notes push the filter open, quiet notes close it — funky quack on guitar, expressive shape on a vocal.

plugins.name: Convolver (JS)
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: 256-tap FIR convolution implemented in pure JavaScript. Identical DSP to Convolver Native — install both and A/B to feel the JS-vs-DEX speed gap. Audibly the same; the JS path stutters faster as you stack more plugins.

plugins.name: Convolver Native
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: 256-tap FIR convolution in pre-compiled DEX bytecode — identical DSP to Convolver (JS) but the inner loop runs at full JVM speed. Roughly 30-80× faster than the JS sibling; install both and stack a few instances to feel the difference.

plugins.name: Fast EQ
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Reference plugin demonstrating the native DSP primitives API. Two cascaded biquads (low-pass + high-pass) run entirely in JVM-native code via host.biquadProcess — roughly 50-100× faster than the same filters written in pure JS.

plugins.name: Resonator
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Karplus-Strong tuned comb. Delay-line feedback rings at the selected pitch, damped by a one-pole LP. Sympathetic-resonance harmonics; high feedback = infinite drone.

plugins.name: Vowel Filter
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Three parallel bandpass resonators tuned to F1/F2/F3 formants — morphs between A·E·I·O·U. Manual or LFO-swept. Talk-wah, robot-mouth, choir effect on a dry voice.

plugins.name: Bit Crusher
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Quantises sample depth and downsamples by holding each value for N hops. From subtle 12-bit grain to full-on Atari beeper character.

plugins.name: Stutter
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Beat-repeat. Captures the first slice of each cycle and replays it N-1 times — turns held vowels into staccato chops, drums into glitch fills.

plugins.name: Tape Stop
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Variable-speed playback from a rolling buffer. Sweep speed → 0 to grind the audio to a tape-deck-unplugged halt with the pitch dropping with it.

plugins.name: Vinyl
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Old-record texture: pink-noise hiss plus randomly-triggered crackle pops with one-pole decay. Set it under a take to age it 40 years instantly.

plugins.name: Chorus
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: LFO-modulated short delay blended with dry. Thickens a single voice into a small ensemble. Classic 80s pad sheen at slow rates, watery shimmer at higher ones.

plugins.name: Flanger
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Short variable delay with feedback — comb-filter sweep produces the trademark jet-plane whoosh. Push feedback for hollow, metallic resonance.

plugins.name: Frequency Shifter
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Bode-style single-sideband shifter — every frequency moves by N Hz (not by ratio), breaking harmonic relationships. 12-stage Hilbert allpass network. Inharmonic, metallic, alien.

plugins.name: Phaser
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: 4-stage swept allpass with feedback. Whoosh that climbs and falls through the spectrum — MXR / Small Stone territory. Feedback turns notches into resonant peaks.

plugins.name: Rotary Speaker
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Leslie cabinet sim — crossover splits the signal into bass drum and treble horn, each modulated by its own Doppler-delay LFO. Two-speed switching ramps like real motor inertia. Hammond B-3 / Procol Harum.

plugins.name: Tremolo
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Amplitude wobble via a sine LFO. Surf-rock chop, vintage amp pulse, slow-rate vocal swell — all the same engine, different rate and depth.

plugins.name: Vibrato
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Pure pitch wobble via LFO-modulated delay tap — no dry blend, so no comb filtering. Subtle warmth at low depth, seasick wobble at high.

plugins.name: Detune Doubler
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: ADT-style doubler: two granular voices flat/sharp by N cents and a few ms late, blended under the dry. Subtle thickening to in-your-face Bee Gees shimmer.

plugins.name: Harmonizer
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Two parallel granular pitch shifters tuned to musical intervals under the dry voice. Defaults to a 3rd + 5th — instant three-part vocal harmony, Eventide style.

plugins.name: Pitch Shifter
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Granular pitch shift over ±2 octaves with cents-precision detune. Two Hann-windowed grains crossfaded — Eventide H910 / SoundTouch family. Vocal harmonies, demon growls, chipmunks.

plugins.name: Gated Reverb
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Six-comb plate reverb followed by a hard envelope gate — huge, dense, then abruptly silent. The Phil Collins / Hugh Padgham 80s drum sound on a vocal.

plugins.name: Plate Reverb
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Schroeder topology — four parallel feedback combs with per-tap damping, diffused through two series allpasses. Dense shimmery plate flavour from 60s/70s records.

plugins.name: Shimmer Reverb
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Lush reverb tail with a granular octave-up pitch shift baked into the feedback path. Each generation of echoes climbs an octave — Eno-style ambient bloom, Strymon BigSky territory.

plugins.name: Spring Reverb
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Eight-stage allpass dispersion network feeding two cross-coupled delay lines — the trademark drippy, chirpy boing of a Fender guitar amp tank or Hammond organ.

plugins.name: Megaphone
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Bullhorn / drill-sergeant voice. Steep band-pass + 2 kHz honk resonance + asymmetric soft-clip cone distortion + post-LP to tame the fizz. Drop on shouted vocals or radio-comm chatter.

plugins.name: Telephone
plugins.author: Vocal Monitor
plugins.description: Band-pass 300 Hz–3.4 kHz with a touch of soft codec crunch. Classic 'caller on the other end' effect.
